name: Field Trip to Hidden Villa Farms
description: Exploring animal habitats, how animals adapt to their environment to survive and how they help it thrive. Parents can sign up to chaperone on the Google Doc provided.

name: Tissue and Hand Sanitizer Donations Needed
description: The classroom is low on tissue stock and hand sanitizer. Parents can donate if willing.

name: Valentine's Day Celebration
description: PARENTS: Bring 1 Valentine's card for all 22 friends in the class and leave the 'To:' section blank. Wear pajamas to school.

name: Sports-Themed Shirt Spirit Day
description: PARENTS: Send child to school in a sports-themed shirt.

name: Label New Items
description: PARENTS: Over the holidays, the kids have grown. Please label new sweaters, clothes, and jackets with their name.

name: PTA General Meeting
description: Join us for our next PTA meeting!

name: Nowruz (Iranian New Year) Staff Luncheon
description: Please join us as we treat our staff to a delicious luncheon to celebrate the upcoming Iranian New Year and the first day of spring!

name: Variety Show
description: Gearing up for our upcoming Variety Show and need parent volunteers to help make it a success! Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands and Concession Organizer. We are also looking for a volunteer who can provide a digital keyboard for the event. To apply, sign up to share your talent - sing, rap, dance, lip sync, magic, musical instrument, cheer performance, skit, monologue, jump rope, yo yo, puppet show, comedy routine, impressions, mime, martial arts demo, poetry, baton twirling.

name: Multicultural Fair
description: This year's Multicultural Fair will take place. A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance.

name: Yearbook Cover Contest
description: Los Alamitos PTA is inviting all Los Alamitos 5th graders to enter their drawings in our Yearbook cover contest. 2 winners will be selected to be displayed on the front and back cover, by the Yearbook committee panel.

name: 5th Grade Baby Photos
description: 5th grade parents — start gathering those adorable baby photos for the 5th Grade Baby Pages! They are due by March 31st! Please send them to your classroom parent yearbook rep and include your child's full name with the photo.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!! Helping these new & growing readers is super fun and rewarding!

name: PTA Board Positions
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! More details about specific positions will be shared soon, but if you're interested in getting involved, please email us or connect with any of our current board members.

name: Incoming 2025/26 Castillero 6th Grade Parents
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants. If you are interested in getting involved, please contact Stephanie Pearson-Phillips.
